title: Spectral coarse spaces based on indefinite operators: the $H_k$-GenEO method
summary: GenEO (`Generalised Eigenvalue problems on the Overlap') is a method for constructing coarse spaces used in the preconditioning of iterative solvers for discrete PDEs. This method combines a (small) number of modes of local PDE eigenproblems to obtain a global coarse space. A coarse solve is then combined with local solves of the global PDE to obtain the preconditioner. A substantial theory for GenEO has been developed for the case when the local elgenproblems are positive semi-definite.
